source.title: Gerda - Soothing Siren
source.name: Gerda
source.description: A fearless Tank who excels at disrupting enemy attacks in battle.

skills.name: Splashing Fun

description.raw: Gerda uses a wooden ladle to splash spring water within a 2-tile radius, healing affected allies for 120% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) HP and dealing 140% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to affected enemies. Enemies affected are put to sleep for 1s and cannot move or act. Each time a target receive healing equal to 10% of their max HP or is healed 3 times by Gerda's hot spring, the sleep extends by 0.5s up to 3s.
active: Gerda uses a wooden ladle to splash spring water within a 2-tile radius, healing affected allies for 120% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) HP and dealing 140% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to affected enemies.
Enemies affected are put to sleep for 1s and cannot move or act.
Each time a target receive healing equal to 10% of their max HP or is healed 3 times by Gerda's hot spring, the sleep extends by 0.5s up to 3s.

skills.description_lite: Gerda heals nearby allies and puts enemies to sleep.

skills.name: Spring Therapy

description.raw: When a battle starts, Gerda leaps forward up to 3 tiles and stomps the ground to unleash a spring, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with an interruption effect to enemies within 1 tile. Then she creates a hot spring within a 2-tile radius. Allies within this area recover 25% (ATK-based) + 2% (SP-based) HP per second, while enemies recover 4% (ATK-based) HP per second (capped at 0.5% of their max HP). Gerda is unaffected while casting this skill.
active: When a battle starts, Gerda leaps forward up to 3 tiles and stomps the ground to unleash a spring, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with an interruption effect to enemies within 1 tile.
Then she creates a hot spring within a 2-tile radius.
Allies within this area recover 25% (ATK-based) + 2% (SP-based) HP per second, while enemies recover 4% (ATK-based) HP per second (capped at 0.5% of their max HP).
Gerda is unaffected while casting this skill.

skills.description_lite: Gerda leaps forward when a battle starts, interrupting nearby enemies and creating a hot spring.

skills.name: Mighty Smash

description.raw: Gerda smashes an enemy with a wooden ladle, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage and stunning them for 1.5s. At the same time, Gerda gains a 340% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) shield for 8s.
active: Gerda smashes an enemy with a wooden ladle, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage and stunning them for 1.5s.
At the same time, Gerda gains a 340% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) shield for 8s.

skills.description_lite: Gerda smashes an enemy, stunning them while gaining a shield for herself.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Gerda reduces her damage taken by 12% during battle.
active: Gerda reduces her damage taken by 12% during battle.

text: Gerda reduces her damage taken by 16% during battle.
Gerda reduces her damage taken by 20% during battle.

skills.description_lite: Gerda reduces her damage taken during battle.

skills.name: Spring of Life

description.raw: Gerda increases the healing received from the allied hot spring by 120%. Each time an ally is healed by it, the cooldown of Mighty Smash is reduced by 0.2s.
active: Gerda increases the healing received from the allied hot spring by 120%.
Each time an ally is healed by it, the cooldown of Mighty Smash is reduced by 0.2s.

text: Increases the healing received from the allied hot spring by 150%.
When an ally enters an allied hot spring for the first time, they become unaffected for 5s.
Increases the healing received from the allied hot spring by 180%.

skills.description_lite: Gerda increases the healing received from the hot spring and reduces the cooldown of Mighty Smash whenever an ally is healed by the hot spring.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When Gerda stomps the ground during Spring Therapy, she stuns enemies for 2s instead of interrupting them.
active: When Gerda stomps the ground during Spring Therapy, she stuns enemies for 2s instead of interrupting them.

skills.description_lite: Gerda no longer interrupts enemies during Spring Therapy but stuns them instead.
